title: Bounded gaps between primes (Zhang, Annals of Mathematics 2014)
summary: Yitang Zhang proved in the Annals of Mathematics (2014) that infinitely many pairs of consecutive primes differ by less than 7×10^7.
body: In the Annals of Mathematics, Volume 179, Issue 3 (pages 1121–1174, published online 1 May 2014), Yitang Zhang of the University of New Hampshire proved that lim inf as n goes to infinity of (p_{n+1} − p_n) is less than 7×10^7, where p_n is the n-th prime. The paper's abstract states the result as a theorem: "It is proved that" the lim inf of the consecutive prime gap is below 7×10^7. On the method, the abstract describes it as a refinement of recent work of Goldston, Pintz and Yıldırım on small gaps between consecutive primes, and says that a major ingredient of the proof is a stronger version of the Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem, applicable when the moduli are free from large prime divisors only. The paper was received 17 April 2013 and accepted 21 May 2013.
